input.quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.
input.rationale: No most-favoured-nation obligation is imposed on Customer anywhere in the agreement. Searches for "no less favo(u)rable", "most favored", "best price", "discount" and "any other customer" returned nothing, and the pricing provision (§ 4.1 Charges, p0052) simply provides that Charges are set out in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms, with no obligation on us to extend IBM terms given to third parties or to match third-party offers. § 14.16 (Freedom of Action) expressly confirms each party may enter into similar agreements with others, which is the opposite of an MFN burden on us. This meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer); no MFN in our favour is granted either, but the rule does not require one, so no redline is warranted.
